brendanm_4: Felix "Parson" Brendanm arrived on Day 3 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Felix "Parson" Brendanm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
At the Hanging Bridge, Felix "Parson" Brendanm and Yann Vee exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

At Saint-Ash crossroads, Konrad Erikvukk of the Concord and Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
brunoescobar36: Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar tried to describe the smell of Dunmarrow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar helped stack spare sandbags at R-F16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A shell landed square in R-F16. They found Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
The papers say Anselm Brunoescobar. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar's eyes. Nobody in R-F16 argues.
Anselm Brunoescobar fixed the strap on Gideon Allistofeari's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
grz_zag420: Lucien Zag came up on Day 4 carrying news from Coldwater. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Lucien Zag traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
heheheha1939: Severin Heheheha unpacked a frozen apple at S-F14. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Severin Heheheha's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Severin Heheheha watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. Orders came through: Severin Heheheha is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a frozen apple.
Felix Varsikasikra saw Severin Heheheha freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Felix said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
A clear shot from S-F14. Severin Heheheha gravely wounded Felix "Bones" Owenhart and slid back down below the parapet.
juizy_44: Walter Juizy arrived with the Day 4 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Walter Juizy worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Juizy. Walter Juizy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
